# Tenzi Resources

> Free market data, dashboards, and operational runbooks for Australian general insurance (GI) brokers and licensees, published by Tenzi (tenzi.ai / Tenzi Pty Ltd). The data products are built from the ASIC AFS licensee and Authorised Representative (AR) registers on data.gov.au. No paywall, no sign-up gate. New data lands monthly, announced by a one-email monthly brief.

Key facts:

- Publisher: Tenzi Pty Ltd, Melbourne, Australia — the marketing site is tenzi.ai; this subdomain is the free data arm
- Coverage: Australian general insurance broking — AR movement (joiners, leavers, AFSL switches), AR demographics, licensee network metrics
- Cadence: monthly movement reports; dashboards refreshed as ASIC register data lands
- Contact: roshan@tenzi.ai

## Data & reports

- [GI Broker Movement Dashboard](https://resources.tenzi.ai/reports/gi-broker-movement-dashboard.html): AR movement across Australian GI licensees, January to April 2026
- [GI Broker AR Movement — monthly reports](https://resources.tenzi.ai/reports/gi-broker-movement-june-2026.html): who joined, left, and switched AFSLs each month (April, May, June 2026 editions live)
- [Profile of the Average GI Broker AR](https://resources.tenzi.ai/reports/gi-broker-ar-profile.html): tenure, geography, and concentration of Australia's GI broker ARs
- [GI Broker Whitespace Map](https://resources.tenzi.ai/reports/gi-broker-whitespace-map.html): interactive region map of where Australian business growth is outrunning GI broker coverage (ABS CABEE × ASIC register)
